item.title: Interactive Notebook - Jupyter
item.description: 1. Introduction Jupyter Notebook (formerly IPython notebook) is an interactive notebook that supports running more than 40 programming languages. Jupyter Notebook is in fact a web application that lets you create and share program documents, with support for live code, mathematical equations, visualizations, and Markdown.
